readsRolesNote: the theme reads every standard role variable itself (var(--ds-*, <its own value>) on every colour, corner and face, role-variables.mjs; feat/ds-role-variables, 15/10/2026): the slot writes the role values only, for both sides (role-values.mjs), and none of the per-template patches it carried before (templateVars, followRules, bandButtons, shapeRules, status, omit, fontVars). followRulesNote: the few places the published 1.7.22 gives the wrong role (probe v10, 18/10/2026), read at the source from 1.7.23 (emdash-tracy-business-source.json); kept here because sites built from 1.7.20-1.7.22 never update their theme: the marketing kit form's step labels and its region arrow are written in the ink band's meta words (text-on-ink-meta) on the card, 1.91:1 under Moxie and Figma light (CON-2), so they take the page's meta words; the empty marks (the kit form's check, the search filter's, the kit slides' timeline dots) fill with the accent band (bg-forest), which a dark system lowers into the page (Figma dark rgb(21,20,68) on its card, LAYOUT-3), so they take the text colour, which stands out on every ground and keeps the timeline's current dot (the accent) apart. The header's "Request a quote" (btn-forest, and the same button in the phone menu, both on the page ground) fills with the accent band, which Figma dark leaves at #151444 on its #141414 page (1.07:1): the button stood out only by its words (look review 18/10/2026); it takes the readable accent text with the page colour for its words, as the template draws it (its forest is its forest text, #14483a on #f5f3ee), which stands 4.5:1 or more off the page under every system by construction (role-values.mjs) and its words read the same 4.5:1 on it; the accent itself was not used, Mailchimp light's #ffe01b sits 1.32:1 on its white page. shapeRules: the header's square search button stood beside the call to action, which wears the system's button corner (a pill under Moxie and Figma, BTN-1 row shape); it takes the same corner, so the header row keeps one shape. No system worn: the slot is empty, none of this is written. Found by the 15 featured systems (19/10/2026; 1.7.23 fixed the same at its source, sites on 1.7.20-1.7.22 keep these rules): a system whose accent is dark (Airbnb, Eddie, ElevenLabs) gets a mid-grey ink band (#5c5c5c-#6d6d6d) so its accent button stands out there, and the ink band's quieter words (text-on-ink-soft/-muted/-meta, 88/84/70% of its words) read 3.46-4.25:1 on it (CON-1): they take the ink band's own words (on-ink; 1.7.23 mixes 96/94/92%, a step the slot has no role for), the kit form's card labels above keep the page's meta (the more specific rule). The home page's All chip (chip-active !bg-forest) is filled with the accent band but wrote the ink band's words, 3.03-3.96:1 under Mailchimp, Linear and the dark sides of Airbnb, Eddie, ElevenLabs: it takes the accent band's words. The Topbar's | divider (text-on-forest-line) read 2.49:1 under Airbnb's dark side (grey band #898989): it takes the band's words too (1.7.23 mixes 75%); the band's underlines are border colours and keep the template's line
modesNote: the theme has a light/dark switch (.ng-theme-toggle, data-theme on html): the slot emits the system's own side under the side the system is, and the other side derived from it (src/derive.mjs), and does not hide the switch (Akemi 13/10/2026: hiding it is a bug; MODE-2).
